requirements.description: The set of requirements - contains no findings as the assessment has not yet occurred.

groups.description: A set of descriptions for the requirement groups.

items.description: An input or attribute used in the run.

inputs.description: The input(s) or attribute(s) to be used in the run.

checksum.description: Cryptographic checksum for baseline integrity verification.

remediation.description: Optional reference to automated remediation resources (Ansible playbooks, Terraform scripts, etc.) for implementing the security controls defined in this baseline.

depends.description: The set of dependencies this baseline depends on.

generator.description: The tool that generated this file.

description: Information on the set of requirements that can be assessed, including baseline metadata and requirement definitions.
title: HDF Baseline

descriptions.description: Array of labeled descriptions. At least one description with label 'default' must be present. Convention: place default description first. Common labels: 'default', 'check', 'fix', 'rationale'.

severity.description: Explicit severity rating. Typically derived from impact score but provided explicitly for clarity.

Baseline_Requirement.description: A requirement definition without assessment results.
Baseline_Requirement.title: Baseline Requirement

label.description: Description category. The 'default' label is required for the primary description. Common labels: 'default', 'check', 'fix', 'rationale'. Tools may use custom labels.

Baseline_Requirement_Descriptions.description: Array of labeled descriptions. At least one description with label 'default' must be present.
Baseline_Requirement_Descriptions.title: Baseline Requirement Descriptions
